settings.label: Realistic flight
settings.info: Off: arcade (the disc tilts with the stick and springs back, it never tips over). On: a light helicopter (H125 class): a collective lever that stays where set (~50 % hovers, more up high), power limit, torque yaw, no self-levelling, vortex ring, blade stall near VNE; negative g bumps the mast (a crash). Loops need speed and positive g. Switches in flight too.

settings.label: Assist (realistic)
settings.info: Damps the helicopter's turn rates (slower, steadier response to the stick). It never levels it: centred, the stick keeps whatever attitude it has. 0: the bare rotor.

settings.label: Stick sensitivity (realistic)
settings.info: How hard the cyclic and the pedals turn it.

settings.label: Rotor speed (picture)
settings.info: 100 %: as in the game's own drop scenes (the main rotor 1000 degrees a second).
